# Fabrexa AI Ollama

> Fabrexa AI Ollama is a self-hosted Telegram bot for chatting with an LLM running through Ollama on your own computer.

The project uses Telegram as the chat interface and Ollama for model inference. It supports streamed replies, custom personality prompts, recent conversation context, and optional short-term and long-term memory. Telegram transports messages, while model inference and Fabrexa runtime files remain on the configured host machine.
